settingsPage.title: Email Receipts
settingsPage.subtitle: Read order confirmations from a mailbox and turn them into itemized transactions

demoRestricted.heading: Restricted in Demo Mode
demoRestricted.body: Connecting a mailbox is disabled in demo mode.

page.title: Email Receipts
page.subtitle: The order-confirmation emails read from your mailbox, and what became of each one

mailbox.heading: Mailbox
mailbox.description: Order confirmations are read from a dedicated mailbox over IMAP. Monize only reads it: it never changes, moves or deletes a message.
mailbox.dedicatedWarning: Use a dedicated mailbox. Every message in the folder is read, so it should hold nothing but order confirmations.
mailbox.encryptionUnavailable: This server cannot encrypt secrets, so a mailbox password or connection cannot be saved. Ask the administrator to set up encryption.

error.title: The mailbox could not be loaded
error.body: The request failed, so nothing is known about your mailbox yet. Try again.

oauth.heading: Connect an account
oauth.explanation: Google and Microsoft 365 usually refuse a plain password. Sign in with the provider instead: you grant Monize access to the mailbox and never type its password here.
oauth.providersUnavailable: Whether Google or Microsoft sign-in is available could not be checked. The manual form below still works.
oauth.badAuthorizationUrl: The server returned a sign-in address that is not a secure web page, so it was not opened.
oauth.notConnected: The connection to {provider} is not active, so the mailbox is not being read. Connect again to resume.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect the mailbox?
disconnectDialog.message: Monize will delete its stored access to {provider} and stop reading the mailbox. Emails already stored are kept.

oauth.revokeNote: Disconnecting does not remove the permission you granted. To withdraw it, remove Monize on the {provider} permissions page.
oauth.saveFailed: Could not save the mailbox settings

form.intro: Or enter the details of any IMAP mailbox. Most providers need an app password rather than your account password.
form.passwordStoredPlaceholder: A password is stored. Type to replace it.
form.passwordRequiredHelp: Required for a new mailbox, or when the server or user name changes.
form.passwordKeepHelp: Leave blank to keep the stored password. It is never shown again.

test.ok: {count, plural, one {The connection works. The folder holds # message.} other {The connection works. The folder holds # messages.}}

settings.folderHelp: The folder to read. It is opened read-only.
settings.enabledHelp: When on, the mailbox is polled every 15 minutes. You can always use Poll now.
settings.aiModeHelp: Whether the AI provider you configured may be used on receipts. An AI answer is always a proposal or a draft that you approve.

aiModeDescriptions.off: The AI is never called for receipts.
aiModeDescriptions.on_demand: The AI is called only when you press Recognize with AI or Draft parser with AI.
aiModeDescriptions.automatic: The poll asks the AI about a matched receipt that no approved parser could read completely, and drafts a parser for a sender that has none.

settings.autoApplyHelp: Off by default. A proposal is applied without asking only when all of these hold: an approved parser read the whole email, the transaction was found by order number or by exact amount and payee with a single candidate, and the proposal adds up to the cent. Everything else waits for your approval.

status.pollResult: Poll finished: {fetched, plural, one {# email stored} other {# emails stored}}, {skipped} skipped, {processed} processed.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the mailbox?
deleteDialog.message: The mailbox settings and every stored email will be deleted, and open review requests from them dismissed. The emails in the mailbox itself are not touched.

parsers.heading: Parsers
parsers.description: A parser reads the order confirmations of one sender with patterns you write or review. Once approved it runs without the AI.

error.title: The parsers could not be loaded

empty.title: No parsers yet
empty.body: Create one for a sender of order confirmations, or draft one from a stored email on the Email Receipts page.

toasts.changedElsewhere: This parser was changed elsewhere. The list has been reloaded.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the parser?
deleteDialog.message: The parser {name} will be deleted. Emails it already read keep their results.

lookupsError.title: Payees and categories could not be loaded
lookupsError.body: The pickers need them, so the editor cannot open yet. Try again.

editor.draftNote: This parser is a draft. It reads nothing until you approve it.
editor.draftAiNote: The AI drafted this parser from one sample email. Check every pattern against your emails, then approve it from the list. It reads nothing until you do.
editor.domainsHelp: One per line, up to {max}. A sub-domain of a listed domain also matches.
editor.subjectHelp: Optional, one per line, up to {max}. The subject must contain at least one of them, ignoring case.
editor.conflict: This parser was changed elsewhere since you opened it. Reload it to see the current version. Your edits here are not saved.

patterns.globHelp: Each pattern is matched against one whole line of the email, ignoring case. Use {star} for any text and a name in braces, such as {capture}, to capture a value. Each field takes up to {max} patterns, one per line.
patterns.startAfterHint: Optional. Items are read from the line after the first line containing this text.
patterns.stopAtHint: Optional. Items end before the first line containing this text.
patterns.itemPatternsHint: Must capture {name} and either {amount} (the line total) or {price} (the unit price, optionally with {qty}), never both. Example: {name} x {qty} {price}

categories.rulesHelp: The first rule whose pattern matches an item name sets its category. Patterns use the same syntax, for example {example}. Up to {max} rules.
categories.noRules: No category rules. Every item gets the default category.
categories.ruleLimit: The limit of {max} rules is reached.
categories.defaultHelp: Used for items that no rule matches.
categories.shippingHelp: The category of the shipping line.

problems.heading: The parser definition is not valid:

codes.unknown_key: is not something a parser can have
codes.invalid_version: is a version this server does not read
codes.invalid_type: has the wrong kind of value
codes.malformed_capture: has a capture in braces that is not valid
codes.duplicate_capture: uses the same capture name twice
codes.capture_not_allowed: uses a capture name this field does not accept
codes.capture_missing: is missing a capture this field needs
codes.capture_conflict: captures both the line total and the unit price. Use one of them.

test.heading: Test against a stored email
test.help: Reads a stored email with the patterns above, saved or not, and shows what would be found and which transaction it would match. Nothing is written.
test.loadFailed: The stored emails could not be loaded, so there is nothing to test against yet.
test.noReceipts: No emails are stored yet. Poll the mailbox first.
test.matched: Would link the transaction of {date} for {amount} ({payee}), found by {how}.
test.ambiguous: {count, plural, one {# transaction fits} other {# transactions fit}} equally well, so none would be linked until you choose.
test.unmatched: No transaction matches, out of {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}}.

reasons.items_unbalanced: The line items do not add up to the total.
reasons.items_uncategorized: Some line items have no category.
reasons.shipping_uncategorized: The shipping line has no category.

error.title: The emails could not be loaded
error.body: The request failed, so nothing is known about your emails yet. Try again.

empty.title: No emails
empty.body: Order confirmations appear here once the mailbox has been read.
empty.filteredBody: Choose another state to see the rest.
empty.noMailboxBody: No mailbox is connected yet. Connect one to start reading order confirmations.

notices.draftCreated: The AI drafted the parser {name}. It reads nothing until you review and approve it.
notices.draftLink: Review it in the parser settings

ignoreDialog.title: Ignore this email?
ignoreDialog.message: The email {subject} will propose nothing, and its open review request will be dismissed.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this email?
deleteDialog.message: The stored email {subject} will be deleted and its open review request dismissed. The message in the mailbox is not touched, and a later poll will not fetch it again.

detail.title: Email receipt

error.title: The email could not be loaded

detail.subject: Subject

reasons.too_large: The email is larger than the size limit, so it was stored without being read.
reasons.undecodable: The email could not be decoded, so it was stored without being read.
reasons.draft_failed: The AI could not draft a parser for this sender.
reasons.parser_invalid: The parser for this sender is not valid. Edit it in the parser settings.
reasons.no_total: The parser found no total in this email.
reasons.no_items: The parser found no line items.
reasons.items_unbalanced: The line items do not add up to the total.
reasons.items_uncategorized: Some line items have no category.
reasons.shipping_uncategorized: The shipping line has no category.
reasons.amount_differs: The parsed total differs from the transaction amount, so only a description is proposed.
reasons.proposal_fallback: The itemized proposal was refused, so only a description is proposed.
reasons.nothing_to_propose: The email adds nothing to this transaction.
reasons.proposal_refused: The proposal was refused, so nothing was proposed.

detail.notParsed: Nothing has been read from this email yet.
detail.candidatesHelp: Several transactions fit this email equally well. Choose the one it paid for.

picker.heading: Choose the transaction
picker.help: No transaction was matched automatically. These are your transactions from {from} to {to}, the days around the email. Choose the one it paid for.
picker.error: The transactions could not be loaded.
picker.empty: You have no transactions in this period that can be linked.
picker.emptySearch: No transaction in this period matches the search.
picker.hasMore: Only the first {count} are shown. Use the search to narrow the list.

ai.heading: Choose the transaction for the AI
ai.help: These are your transactions from {from} to {to}, the days around the email. Choose the one the AI should split by the products in the email.

success.body: Connected as {username}. Returning to the settings.

missingParameters.title: This page was opened without a sign-in result
missingParameters.body: Start again from the email receipts settings and use one of the Connect buttons.

failed.title: The mailbox could not be connected
failed.fallback: The server refused the connection. Start again from the email receipts settings.

callback.backLink: Back to the email receipts settings

recognize.title: Recognize with AI
recognize.confirmMessage: This email is linked to the transaction {summary}. The AI will read the email and propose how to split this transaction by product. Continue with this transaction?
recognize.candidatesHeading: Which transaction did the email pay for?
recognize.candidatesHelp: Several transactions fit this email. Choose the one the AI should use, or search for another.
recognize.candidatesError: The transactions that fit could not be loaded.
recognize.queued: Queued: no AI assistant is available to answer now, so the request waits in the AI review inbox for an agent (for example over MCP).
recognize.handoffFailed: The request is queued, but the email could not be opened in the chat. It waits in the AI review inbox for an agent (for example over MCP).
recognize.opened: Opened the chat with the email attached. Read the message and press Send.
recognize.chatPrompt: Recognize the products, quantities and prices in the attached order email and split my transaction of {date} ({payee}, {amount}) by product with a category for each. Claim AI review request {requestId} and submit your proposal for it.
